In an extensive new interview on Clique TV, Apple CEO John Ternus answered a range of questions covering his outlook for the future, the role of technology in his family, how he came to be invited to serve as CEO, his thoughts on Vision Pro, and more.

New Apple CEO John Ternus discusses a wide range of topics in interview covering his early days in the role

Clique TV's Mouloud Achour sat down with Apple's new CEO, John Ternus, earlier this month for an interview that was released over the weekend.

Ternus discussed a number of topics in the interview, including making a strong case for the Apple Vision Pro. As one of his first major interviews since taking on the role, he was of course asked about the transition.
